Analysts highlighted Adani Enterprises, HDFC AMC, Hyundai Motor India and Dixon Technologies as bullish technical setups, while geopolitical risks warrant continued near-term caution.

title: Dick's Sporting Goods shares slump 22% as Foot Locker weakness sparks outlook cut
description: Dick’s Sporting Goods shares plunged 22% after second-quarter earnings missed estimates and the retailer cut its full-year outlook. Weak Foot Locker sales, integration challenges and cautious consumer demand overshadowed stronger comparable sales and revenue growth at its core Dick’s business.

title: IPO fund diversion: Sebi bars Varanium Cloud, promoter for 7 years from markets
description: Sebi has barred Varanium Cloud and promoter Harshawardhan Sabale from the securities market for seven years, citing misleading disclosures, inflated financials and diversion of IPO and rights issue funds. The regulator ordered recovery of diverted money and disgorgement of unlawful gains.

title: HEG demerger to take effect on September 1; record date fixed for September 7
description: HEG will implement its demerger from September 1, creating separate listed companies for graphite electrodes and advanced materials. September 7 is the record date, with shareholders receiving new shares in a 1:1 ratio approved under the composite scheme of arrangement.

title: US Markets Today: US stocks rebound on tech recovery ahead of Nvidia earnings, inflation data
description: US stocks rose on Tuesday as technology shares rebounded ahead of Nvidia’s quarterly results and key US inflation data. The Nasdaq led gains, while chipmakers Intel, Micron and AMD advanced. Investors also tracked Treasury yields, Iran tensions and Federal Reserve policy ahead of the PCE inflation report and Jackson Hole speech.

title: Euro zone yields dip from multi-year highs as oil falls on Iran sanctions
description: On Tuesday, government bond yields across the Euro zone saw a drop from recent peaks, accompanied by falling oil prices as traders evaluated newly imposed U.S. sanctions on Iran. Additionally, money markets adjusted their expectations regarding potential rate hikes by the European Central Bank this year. Meanwhile, recent data highlighted a rebound in German economic growth during the second quarter, with business sentiment climbing to its highest in a year.

title: Sterling hovers near six-month high underpinned by BoE rate hike expectations
description: The pound is maintaining its position close to a six-month peak against the dollar, buoyed by expectations of interest rate hikes. However, analysts predict a minor decline in currency value as year-end economic data rolls in. Attention turns to soaring government debt ahead of the October budget announcement, as the UK aims for significant investments in affordable housing in London.

title: UK gilt yields fall to lowest since mid-August as oil price slides
description: British government bond yields have reached their lowest point since mid-August, with ten-year gilt yields dropping markedly to levels not observed since August 14. This shift follows a substantial decrease in oil prices today. The patterns in gilt yields resonate with those seen in U.S. Treasury yields, as even thirty-year gilt yields have fallen to their lowest values since mid-August.
